inputPolicy.lengthSemantics: Dart String.length, consistent with existing UI/controller text limits. Title must be nonblank; imported facts are never trimmed or truncated.
inputPolicy.cryptoBoundary: BackupCodec decrypt and WebDavClient.restore return compatible raw snapshots. Backup/export upload readback and pruning share this decode path; strict restore preview and controller import enforce external input limits before any replacement.

verifiedScenarios: Accept title lengths 1 and 80 and note lengths 0 and 2000, preserving future metadata fields.
Reject title 81 and note 2001 in both preview and direct controller import before replacement/protection; memory snapshot, persisted state, backup and exact pasted draft remain intact.
Accepted boundary import preserves full title/note text, protects original facts, and can retry after protection failure.

Old SharedPreferences facts with title 1000 and note 2001 migrate to SQLite, allow ordinary settings edits, reopen intact and survive compatible sync encode/assemble; rejected reimport changes neither business revision nor protection/change-log counts.
Frozen SQLite schema 1 migrates with title 1000 and note 2001 intact; explicit recovery of a local protection backup also preserves these facts.
Encrypted backup export/decrypt stays lossless for oversized legacy facts; encrypted-file and mocked WebDAV restore preview reject them and leave target storage intact.
Authenticated remote title 80 and note 2000 reach initial sync preview without truncation.

A remote title 81 or note 2001 rejects a page containing earlier valid objects: snapshot, business revision, shadow, cursor, highWater, base and pending remain unchanged; only allowlisted failure metadata is persisted.
Invalid authenticated push-conflict input preserves frozen outbox ciphertext, acknowledged remote/base state and local facts.
